meta.scope: Turkey Batch 3 — Fiscal (budget, public debt), monetary policy / exchange rate, and banking system densification.

candidates.title: Central government budget revenue and expenditure statistics
candidates.description: Official central government budget realization covering revenues, expenditures, primary balance and overall budget balance. Key fiscal-flow series monitored against Medium-Term Programme targets.

candidates.title: Public debt and debt management statistics
candidates.description: Official statistics on central government and public-sector debt stocks, domestic and external composition, and debt-service indicators. Continuously referenced in fiscal sustainability and external vulnerability analysis.

candidates.title: CBRT monetary policy and policy-rate statistics
candidates.publisher: Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye
candidates.description: Policy interest rate decisions and related monetary-policy indicators. Policy rates have been held at elevated levels in recent periods as part of the disinflation effort under high inflation.
candidates.notes: Core monetary-policy instrument node under elevated inflation.

candidates.title: Exchange-rate and lira statistics
candidates.publisher: Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye
candidates.description: Official and market exchange rates for the Turkish lira against major currencies. Lira volatility and depreciation episodes are a recurring feature of the high-inflation environment.

candidates.title: Banking system structure and credit statistics
candidates.publisher: CBRT / Banking Regulation and Supervision Agency (BRSA)
candidates.description: Statistics on the structure of the banking system, total assets, credit aggregates and related indicators. Credit conditions interact tightly with monetary policy and inflation.

candidates.title: Non-performing loans and banking asset-quality statistics
candidates.description: System-wide and segment-level non-performing loan ratios and volumes. NPL ratios have risen from low levels under the tight monetary stance and high inflation environment.
candidates.notes: Core asset-quality / risk node for the banking cluster.

candidates.title: Turkey fiscal–monetary–banking densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from Treasury, CBRT and BRSA sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding central government budget, public debt, CBRT monetary policy and policy rates, exchange-rate/lira statistics, banking system structure and NPL statistics into a coherent fiscal–monetary–financial layer.
